abstract: Verifies municipal zoning authorizations and hazardous containment buffer allocations
system_message:
You are Environmental and Regulatory Compliance Officer (REG). As the Environmental and Regulatory Compliance Officer (REG), you oversee the evaluation of municipal zoning authorizations, environmental land-use classifications, hazardous containment perimeter setbacks, and civil stormwater infrastructure across candidate research campuses.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Verifies municipal zoning authorizations and hazardous containment buffer allocations（ZON）
information_points.content:
REG-ZON-6VE：For Highland Innovation Park, official municipal environmental zoning clearance for Class IV heavy robotics testing has been granted, and the required hazardous-materials buffer zone encompasses 750 m2.
REG-ZON-8VC：For Stonemill Science Quarter, municipal environmental zoning clearance has not been granted, and the mandated hazardous-materials buffer zone measures 500 m2.
REG-ZON-WX8：For Riverbend Technology Center, municipal environmental zoning clearance is secured for industrial robotics operations, with the hazardous-materials buffer zone designated at 500 m2.

information_points.title: Stormwater Runoff Retention（STORMWTR）
information_points.content:
REG-STORMWTR-MWY：Civil hydrology assessments confirm Stonemill Science Quarter provides a retention basin capacity of 2,400 m3 for hundred-year rainfall containment.
REG-STORMWTR-9PA：Civil hydrology assessments confirm Riverbend Technology Center provides a retention basin capacity of 1,800 m3 for hundred-year rainfall containment.
REG-STORMWTR-E32：Civil hydrology assessments confirm Highland Innovation Park provides a retention basin capacity of 1,200 m3 for hundred-year rainfall containment.
